AMENDMENT NO. 1 dated as of March 30, 2024 to the Credit Agreement dated as of November 18, 2021, among Bluewater Marine Group, Inc., as Borrower, the Lenders party hereto and Coastal Federal Bank, as Administrative Agent.

SECTION 1. Amendments . Section 7.09 of the Credit Agreement is hereby amended by replacing "$10,000,000" with "$60,000,000".

SECTION 2. Effectiveness . This Amendment shall become effective on March 30, 2024.
